data.comment:
# Comfy Mirelo SFX 2.0- Text to SFX

Generate sound effects from a text prompt with Mirelo sfx-2.0: name the sound, its material, space and intensity in one line and get a 48 kHz mono audio file, up to 10 minutes. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_mirelo_text_to_sfx.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: Heavy rain on a tin roof with distant thunder
